question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to 100 words.
guide_solution: A famous astronomer, Nicolaus Copernicus was born in Poland. He said that the earth rounds the sun. He said that stars are static and they have no birth and death. Galileo, an Italian scientist, had great intelligence in mathematics and as tronomy.
